description: This Dart file implements a Flutter StatefulWidget called WorkoutDetailScreen, which displays workout details including a countdown timer and a list of exercises. It includes UI components for starting, stopping, and resetting the timer, and renders exercise details with icons.

classes.name: WorkoutDetailScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that displays workout details along with a countdown timer and exercise list.

classes.name: _WorkoutDetailScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the timer and UI for WorkoutDetailScreen.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Starts the countdown timer if not already running.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Resets the timer to the initial workout total minutes.

methods.name: _iconFor
methods.description: Returns an icon based on exercise icon name.
